race.comment: GRAFTERBURNERS (6) finished third to Tempted over this track and trip in the Arrowfield last April and looks to be near his best after running fourth in the G2 Premiere Stakes over 1200m here. Rawiller goes aboard from the low draw and is due for a change in luck. CHARM STONE (12) sat on the solid tempo first up in the G1 Manikato Stakes over 1200m at Caulfield when collared late by Jimmysstar from a wide gate to run third. Clearly returned in great shape and sure to be thereabouts. MARHOONA (15) The Galaxy winner who gets a better set-up third up with the visors going on. Caught the eye when third in the G2 Premiere Stakes. A top-three finish is on the cards. GENEROSITY (14) two runs back have only been fair and assess off her close up fifth in the Galaxy and sixth in the Sangster last prep. OVERPASS (1) tough fresh gelding resuming. Fitted with the two sharp trials and can take a hand in the finish despite drawing out.
